summary: Queue consumer with max_retries, dead letter queue, capped backoff and an idempotency claim.

must_not_flag.reason: Retries use the platform retry path, so max_retries = 5 and the dead letter queue apply; delays back off to at most an hour; permanent 4xx failures are acked; D1 ON CONFLICT prevents duplicate deliveries.

The enqueue route needs the relay token and is limited to 20 messages a minute under one shared key, counted per location. One leaked token from one location is 864,000 messages a month; a 64,000-character body makes a message just over 64,000 bytes, so about six queue operations each, 5.2M in all, $1.67 over the included million. Delivery claims add about 1.7M rows written in D1, inside the allowance. Low.
